title: Flip Fluid on Flip Dots
summary: A hardware project demonstrating fluid simulation animations rendered on flip dot displays - those classic mechanical displays with physical pixels that flip between two states. The author creates realistic fluid dynamics effects using the constraints of a physical dot matrix display.
problem_solved: Brings digital fluid simulation to life using vintage mechanical flip dot display technology
why_valuable: Combines nostalgia of flip dot displays with modern fluid simulation techniques, creating visually captivating real-world physics visualizations
